name: Metadata
description: Finishes the tags on new downloads and on albums you choose: embeds the cover, saves lyrics, adds release details from MusicBrainz, cleans out junk tags, and adds ReplayGain.

settings.label: Embed covers
settings.help: Puts the album cover inside each file: the album folder's cover, or the front cover on the Cover Art Archive.

settings.label: Prefer digital covers
settings.help: Takes a cover from the Cover Art Archive from the album's digital release first, worldwide first, then a plain CD release, because a CD release's cover is often a photo of the case. A cover in the album folder still comes first.

settings.label: Save lyrics files
settings.help: Saves synced lyrics from LRCLIB in an .lrc file next to each track.

settings.label: Embed lyrics
settings.help: Puts lyrics from LRCLIB inside each file: synced when LRCLIB has them, plain otherwise.

settings.label: Add release details
settings.help: Adds the release date, original date, label, catalog number, barcode, ISRC, media, release type, track and disc totals, and sort names from MusicBrainz.

settings.label: Clean tags
settings.help: Removes encoder notes, web links, purchase details, private frames, pictures other than the cover, old ID3v1 and APE tags, and leftover track, disc and album artist fields that disagree with the real ones. Moves MP3 tags to ID3v2.4.

settings.label: Add ReplayGain
settings.help: Measures loudness with ffmpeg and adds track and album gain, for players other than Aurral. Aurral levels volume on its own. Uses a lot of CPU.

settings.label: Replace existing values
settings.help: Off: fills in only what a file is missing. On: also replaces the cover, lyrics, release details, and ReplayGain a file already has.

settings.label: Sweep the library every night
settings.help: Goes through the Library once a night, like a cron job, and does what's turned on above for files that are new or changed since the plugin last handled them. It stops 6 hours after it starts, and a library too big for one night carries on the next. Changing a setting has it look at every file again. With ReplayGain on, the first sweep measures every track.

settings.label: Hour to start the sweep
settings.help: 0 to 23, in the server's time zone. Leave it empty to start at 3. The sweep stops 6 hours later.

settings.label: Dry run
settings.help: Logs what the plugin would change, under plugin:metadata in Aurral's log, without changing any file.
